notes.title: Malum Escape Room
notes.content:
Malum now has an Escape Room level!

This Escape Room challenges your wits like no other. You find yourselves trapped in a dungeon, with a series of puzzles, traps and... other things blocking your escape. But this is still Malum... watch out for the creatures in the dark! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/cf1323dd13917cfb2431eb9987e76ccae909ae11.png[/img]

This update also comes with some quality of life updates, including greatly improved character movement and a UI refresh. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/3bb4e0c801b2bbe9c513ac4f5b7a8830727b7f3b.png[/img]

Explore the dungeon, solve the puzzles and escape together - or die a grizzly chainsaw-related death, who knows?

notes.title: Gotta go fast
notes.content:
This update brings with it some long sought-after balance changes and a new intro level.

[b]Intro Level[/b]
The first level has been completely re-done, now with a much spookier setting and what are [i]definitely [/i]dead corpses hanging from the ceiling. Don't look up! They're definitely dead, and they definitely won't reanimate and kill you. We're absolutely 15% sure of it.

[b]Speed Increase[/b]
You'll find you move much faster in the game now, which should speed up your demon-hunting antics. We have to keep things fair though, so the demons will also move [i]much[/i] faster than before. That may sound terrifying, but if anything it will make you death quicker, so there's a comforting thought.

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Halloween is upon us - time for a Malum update!

[list]
[*][b]New Characters[/b] - Peggy and Rob are the latest additions to the squad. 
[*][b]New Items[/b] - Some substantial equipment options are now available. These consumables will let you see artefacts and even demons through walls, and one of them will even trap demons in place.
[*][b]Achievements[/b] - A new secret achievement is out there, and the long awaited Magoroku Challenge will keep the masochists out there busy for a while.
[*][b]Pets[/b] - Frederick the duck is a rare spawn that can be found in levels. If you catch him he'll be a permanent new addition to your van.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/42649fba646d98fd972d14b6b98fff77c7fcbca4.png[/img]

On top of this all cosmetics have been reduced in price throughout Halloween, so this is the perfect time to unlock the new characters and get the Halloween theme for your van.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/d23849751a27f4c2638b6541ad19eb9956d9e971.png[/img]

[b]Future Updates[/b]
The observant among you may have noticed the above image is not set in an existing level. That's because it's from [b]Evilator[/b] - the new map coming in November. 

This adventure will be very different and more replayable than the others. The Evilator will transport you to a variety of locations, some new and some old, and you'll have a fixed amount of time to do what it demands before its doors shut on you forever. Will you be able to ride the Evilator all the way to its gruesome finale?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/75275f659700d1a694868b0f56c0415820178427.png[/img]

On a personal note I'd love to thank the community and everyone who has helped to shape Malum into what it is today. Your feedback and support has been invaluable and I love working on this game. So thanks again, and I can't wait to get more awesome content out there for you :)

notes.title: Progression Update
notes.content:
Tired of fighting Demons without getting paid? Ever dreamed of sprucing up your RV to make it a bit more festive? Have you ever wanted a sandwich? Well, then this is the update for you!

[h1]Bringing home the bacon[/h1]
You can now earn money for completing missions. Harder difficulties will get you more money of course, and you can earn extra cash by finding precious scrolls that have been hidden across the levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/d874400145e4b8902b7cb29b64542aae5c0c026c.png[/img]

[h1]Consumables[/h1]
What can you do with the money? Well you can buy sandwiches, of course. These are consumable items that instantly replenish your stamina bar. Energy pills will make you run faster, and you can also bring a spare battery in for your flashlight. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/db1614a5388cc8a4409adec76db48ecaeb81d4ea.png[/img]

Pick carefully as you only have one inventory slot - unless you unlock more of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/184cb23716c5434ab8a191eb77b9869d4d99eaab.png[/img]

[h1]Customization[/h1]
You can also spend your paycheck on decorating your van, accessible from the new laptop in your RV. The first upgrade available is Halloween-themed, just in time for the holiday itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/6d8f60951cce1a235fcd4a9fca394806d65b600a.png[/img]

This is just the start of the shops and progression systems. In time we'll find plenty more useful tools and upgrades to add.

Happy Hunting!

notes.title: A Stunning Update
notes.content:
Good news hunters. Your flashlights are now upgraded with a burst ability, so powerful it can stun Demons. You only have a few charges so make them count. You might be able to find more batteries in-mission but they will be scarce.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/0d7f9ebd8b8e1e902dd8f098c04b0b6869b59982.png[/img]

We've found the perfect mission for you to try this out. A housewife, purporting to be genuine, has been possessed by a demon and is likely responsible for several disappearances in the area. You should have no trouble dispatching this lesser demon, but be warned; her sass is real.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888697/99a23538c0a8407430d453eec15d72758ab213fa.png[/img]

This update also comes with some additional bug fixes.

Stay posted hunters, there is lots more to come!

notes.title: Balance update
notes.content:
It looks like some poor souls were bouncing out of the game due to it being too hard, so the onboarding has been made a bit gentler. A bigger update for this is coming very soon ;) In the mean time:

[list]
[*]Easy mode is now the default.
[*]Easy mode is now easier (more stamina, demons less aggressive).
[*]Average mode stamina increased slightly.
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Hard and Insane modes remain the same.
